trap.label: falso cognato
trap.wrong: Actually I am living in Boston.
trap.right: Currently I am living in Boston.
trap.why: “Actually” parece “atualmente”, mas significa “na verdade”. Para “atualmente” use currently ou these days.

mcq.q: The speaker says “Maybe it’s true.” His attitude is:

fix.wrong: I am not agree with the speaker.
fix.right: I don’t agree with the speaker.
fix.why: Agree é verbo, não adjetivo: não se usa “be agree”.

fix.wrong: The speaker was very exciting about the news.
fix.right: The speaker was very excited about the news.

fix.wrong: In my opinion, I am thinking it is false.
fix.right: In my opinion, it is false.
fix.why: In my opinion já expressa a opinião; não precisa de “I think”.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o passado: “The speaker sounds sure.”
Reescreva na negativa: “I agree with her.”
Comece com Unfortunately: “The report was late.”
